name: mercy_to_a_dog
title: She Gave Water to a Dying Dog
source: Supply and verify the exact hadith citation before publication. Do not invent a source.

scenes.text: The heat had left an animal desperate for water.
scenes.vo: Under the burning heat, an animal was left desperate for water.
Then someone noticed its suffering and stopped.
Compassion was not only a feeling. It became an act of mercy.

scenes.text: A small deed can carry great weight.
scenes.vo: A small deed, done sincerely, can carry a weight we cannot see.
The lesson is simple: mercy is never wasted.
